gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-perm: Press Start 2P scatters its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart. Noto Sans Old Permic follows with rounded, open-sided forms and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, a friendly sans-serif partner.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-sogd: Retro fun, with every letter pinned far apart. Noto Sans Old Sogdian has a tall x-height, wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk, so extended reading goes down smoothly under Press Start 2P.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-osage: Retro fun, spaced like cut-outs pinned far apart. Press Start 2P brings the play, while Noto Sans Osage fills each line with inflated-looking bowls and sweeping curves that never close up.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Fun, retro, and barely modulated. What stands out most is Noto Sans Osmanya, whose wide, easy s turns and oversized lowercase bring a relaxed side to Press Start 2P.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P swells gently on its curves and pins its letters far apart. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square adds a soaring x-height and crisp gaps.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-onest: Retro fun with a thin hint of modulation. Onest brings short ascenders over big bowls and curves that hold their thickness at the shoulders, a smooth counterweight to Press Start 2P.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-radio-canada: Cut-out spacing, pinned far apart, is the whole personality of Press Start 2P. It does its best work with big, open-looking bowls, while Radio Canada excels at full, tall letters with clear openings.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-radio-canada-big: Press Start 2P goes retro, with letters pinned far apart like cut-outs. Then Radio Canada Big steps in with a monoline skeleton and terminals that finish away from the stem, like glass tubing bent into letters.
gen-righteous-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters like stencil bridges pulled wide. Righteous is best at commanding, line-filling bowls, as if bent from thin steel rod, and the mono handles open counters that breathe.
gen-righteous-gf-golos-text: Commanding and fun, like steel rod bent into letters. Golos Text takes over with a tall x-height and a widely parted s, so whole paragraphs under Righteous run smoothly.
